newsitem.title: USA: One Valley Bancorp ups qtly div, post split.
newsitem.headline: One Valley Bancorp ups qtly div, post split.

text.p: One Valley Bancorp said Tuesday that it raised its quarterly cash dividend by nine percent to $0.21, on a post stock-split basis.
The cash dividend will be paid on all outstanding shares, including additional shares from a five-for-four stock split effected through a 25 percent stock dividend, it said.
The cash dividend will be paid on October 15 to shareholders of record on September 30.
On the stock dividend, shareholders of record on August 29 will receive one additional share for every four held, it said. The stock dividend is payable on September 12.
The company's previous quarterly cash dividend before the stock split was $0.24 a share.
